preconditions.description: The input string s has length between 1 and 10, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in stdin.strip())
preconditions.description: All characters in s are lowercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'NA' or (len(stdout.strip()) == len(stdin.strip()) + 1 and stdout.strip() == stdout.strip()[::-1])
postconditions.description: If possible, the output is a valid palindrome formed by inserting exactly one lowercase letter into s; otherwise, the output is 'NA'.

postconditions.expression: any(stdout.strip() == s[:i] + c + s[i:] for i in range(len(s) + 1) for c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz') if stdout.strip() != 'NA' else False
postconditions.description: The output is formed by inserting exactly one lowercase letter at any position in s (including beginning or end).
